influences.name: Elvis Presley
influences.context: Her musical journey was shaped by the profound influence of legendary figures like Elvis Presley, Patsy Cline, and Hank Williams, whose brilliance left an indelible mark on her artistry.

influences.name: Owen Bradley
influences.context: Lee gives much of the credit for her commercial breakthrough to legendary producer Owen Bradley, who employed Nashville's "A-Team"—pianist Floyd Cramer, saxman Boots Randolph, drummer Buddy Harman, bassist Bob Moore, and guitarists Grady Martin and Hank Garland.

influences.name: The Ink Spots
influences.context: I was a big fan [of the Ink Spots] because of my producer, Owen Bradley. And they used to recite words in their songs. So I said, 'Why not do a recitation [to lengthen the song]?' And so that's where the recitation in 'I'm Sorry' came from.

influences.name: Red Foley
influences.context: it was country star Red Foley who ultimately helped her get her start in the music industry.
